source: 1968 Chevrolet Chassis Service Manual, Wheels and Tires, p.10-3

procedures.title: Tire wear: diagnose
steps: Side (one shoulder) wear: wrong camber, low pressure, crowned roads or fast cornering; camber wears only one side, under-inflation wears both (figure 2 in the manual).
Center wear: mainly over-inflation, which can also cause hidden cord damage.
Uneven/spotty wear (figure 3): unequal caster or camber, bent suspension parts, unbalanced wheels, out-of-round drums, misadjusted brakes, etc.; find and fix the mechanical fault.
Cornering wear (figure 4): hard cornering unloads the inside rear tire so it slips and wears its inner half, looking like negative camber wear.
